pivot_note: the bun (old rig's spine pivot); the same pivot as every girl sheet
draw_order: draw order: lower, upper (torso + left arm), arm_right_<state> (the flashlight is drawn over its arm), head (a girl_head_poses frame at head_offset, or girl_sprint_head)
mood_note: after a sprint: B, the shoulders, collar and arms rise 1-2 px (the hem, the hands and the flashlight stay), the head a frame later

switch_note: calm by default; tired / exhausted after a sprint (MOVEMENT_PLAN 4). Switch at a frame boundary: frame 0 of every mood is her rest pose (exhausted's head 1 px forward)
